sourcePolicy: Prisma supplies complete persisted field discovery; content/entities.ts supplies generic-form editability only.

scope.activeRegistryEntities: apps/web/src/content/entities.ts joined to generated Prisma entity-admin contract

assertions.name: Every active entity has a canonical field inventory
Every persisted Prisma model is classified
Every active canonical field has a write owner

notes: PASS means the live inventory is exhaustive for the active generic entity registry; it does not claim the current owner UI satisfies later T201-T207 presentation requirements.
Unregistered persisted models are retained explicitly so renderer scope cannot be mistaken for complete persistence authority.
